Class TrailingStop

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.TrailingStop
public final class TrailingStop extends Object
The arithmetic of a trailing stop, with no state, shared by order placement, editing and OrderTriggerEngine.

A trailing stop remembers the best price it has seen - the highest bid for a sell, the lowest ask for a buy - and keeps its stop a fixed amount, or percent, behind it. The stop only ever moves in the order's favour: a sell's stop rises as the price does and stays put as it falls, so it locks in gains and sells once the price has fallen the trail away from its high.
